items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: I had Bostic, Earl Bostic... And I go from the sax section. There was Earl Bostic and there was Eugene Hall.

ctx.x: So who was playing on the boats within those years? Who else was in the band?
I had Bostic, Earl Bostic, the late Earl Bostic. Yeah.
